annotations.title: Approve a drafted reply and send it

description: Approve a pending review-queue draft and dispatch it through the lead's channel. THIS SENDS A REAL MESSAGE TO A REAL PERSON — only call it after a human has reviewed and intends to send. Pass confirm: true to proceed. Optional finalBody replaces the draft text before sending. Example: { reviewQueueId, confirm: true }.

confirm.description: This tool has a real-world side effect: it messages real leads, books, moves, or cancels a call, changes a lead's consent, imports leads, writes to a connected calendar or CRM, sends workspace events to an outside URL, or re-triggers downstream automations. Pass confirm: true to proceed; the call is rejected without it.

finalBody.description: Optional edited body to send instead of the drafted text.

idempotencyKey.description: Reuse the same key when retrying this exact approval.
